description.zh: 用上游引擎汇总最近的社区讨论，附来源、日期和互动数据。需要 Python 3.12+，覆盖范围取决于已配置的数据源。
description.en: Research recent community discussion with the upstream engine, citations, dates, and engagement signals. Requires Python 3.12+; coverage varies by configured sources.

example.zh: 最近 30 天，开发者怎样评价本地运行的语音转写工具？给出具体讨论、日期和链接。
example.en: What are developers saying about local transcription tools in the last 30 days? Include dates and source links.

description.zh: 编辑已有中文稿件，精简套话和重复，保留原有事实、语气和作者声音。
description.en: Edit an existing Chinese draft for clarity and natural rhythm while preserving its facts and voice.

example.zh: 润色附件里的中文公告。保留事实和原有语气，列出三处改动及理由。
example.en: Polish the attached Chinese announcement. Preserve facts and tone, and explain three edits.

description.zh: 按 Obsidian 语法整理笔记，维护双链、嵌入、属性和提示块。
description.en: Create and update vault notes with wikilinks, embeds, properties, and callouts.

example.zh: 把这些会议纪要整理到当前 Obsidian 知识库，加上属性、相关笔记双链和行动项。
example.en: Turn the meeting notes into an Obsidian note with properties, backlinks, and action items.

description.zh: 用 Anthropic 原版脚本创建、修改或校验 PowerPoint。生成需要 Node.js / PptxGenJS，渲染预览还需要 LibreOffice。
description.en: Create, edit, or validate PowerPoint decks with Anthropic’s scripts. Authoring uses Node.js and PptxGenJS; rendering also needs LibreOffice.

example.zh: 按附件里的公司模板生成一份 6 页项目进度汇报，保留可编辑文本和图表。
example.en: Use the attached company template to build a six-slide update with editable text and charts.

description.zh: 用 Anthropic 原版工作流清洗、分析和编辑工作簿。需要 Python / openpyxl，公式重算使用 LibreOffice。
description.en: Clean, analyze, and edit workbooks using Anthropic’s workflow. Requires Python and openpyxl; formula recalculation uses LibreOffice.

example.zh: 把附件里的账表按月份归类汇总，保留明细和可重算的公式，输出 XLSX。
example.en: Summarize the attached ledger by month and return an XLSX with source detail and recalculable formulas.

description.en: Extract clean Markdown from HTML pages with Defuddle CLI.

example.en: Show me a practical way to use defuddle in this project.

description.en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

example.en: Show me a practical way to use json-canvas in this project.

description.en: Render Markdown from templates and structured data using Knap CLI. Use when the user asks to apply a Knap template, turn JSON or CSV data into notes, batch-generate Markdown files, or format Defuddle output into a note.

example.en: Show me a practical way to use knap in this project.

description.en: Create and edit Obsidian Bases (.base files) with views, filters, formulas, and summaries. Use when working with .base files, creating database-like views of notes, or when the user mentions Bases, table views, card views, kanban boards, filters, or formulas in Obsidian.

example.en: Show me a practical way to use obsidian-bases in this project.

description.en: Interact with Obsidian vaults using the Obsidian CLI to read, create, search, and manage notes, tasks, properties, and more. description.en: Sync and publish Obsidian vaults from the command line with Obsidian Headless (`ob`), without the desktop app. Use when the user wants to set up or run Obsidian Sync or Obsidian Publish on a server, in CI, or from a terminal, or change a vault's Sync or Publish settings.

example.en: Show me a practical way to use obsidian-headless in this project.
